entities.name: Charles-Daniel de Meuron
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Lieutenant-General Charles-Daniel de Meuron was a Swiss army officer and mercenary who served in the French Revolutionary and Napoleonic Wars. He raised the Regiment de Meuron, which under his command served in both the army of the Dutch East India Company and the British Army.
